response.answer: Banksy's work is featured in the new Lucas Museum in Los Angeles, which showcases a diverse range of art from Star Wars to Banksy. Additionally, a rare Banksy hand-sprayed LP recently sold for thousands, highlighting the enduring appeal and value of his art.

results.title: After a reckoning and the toppling, what is replacing Britain’s symbols of empire? | Society | The Guardian
results.content: Immersive … Stormzy’s 2019 Glastonbury vest, designed by Banksy, at the V and A East. Photograph: James Veysey/Shutterstock [...] Finally made it to the V&A East for The Music Is Black exhibition, which traces 125 years of Black British music, and have been rinsing the playlist ever since. It begins with a sombre look at attempts to stifle Black creativity and expression during enslavement, with a slave voyage map showing that more enslaved Africans were taken from the west Africa coast to Brazil than any other country, manumission papers and the “Slaves’ Bible”, which had any passages on freedom and equality edited out [...] equality edited out to curb rebellion. It moves on to the music Black people brought with them through migration – jazz, blues, lover’s rock, trip-hop in Bristol, ska in Coventry, jungle and grime – effortlessly conveying the role Black musicians have played in shaping the music scene in Britain. No stone is left unturned in this thoroughly immersive exhibition. Angela

results.title: Samsung's Frame Pro isn't just a gorgeous TV, it opened my eyes to art
results.content:
When you’re not watching TV or movies on The Frame, it can display a rotating selection of artwork from the Samsung Art Store. For $50 per year (or $5 per month), you’ll have access to thousands of works from museums and galleries around the world. You can also opt for a free version, which cycles through 30 different artworks a month, and about 70 complimentary images available to stream. [...] ## Most viewed

## Most viewed [...] Amazon’s new Ember Artline series runs cheaper: about $900 for a 55in TV. Though the art store is free, it only offers about 2,000 pieces and does not come with as many well-known works. I do like that the basic magnetic frame comes in 10 different colors and is included with these TVs, while Samsung still charges $200 to $300 extra.
